bio: Pamper yourself to a luxurious Afternoon Tea experience at the Corus Hyde Park Hotel. This 200-year-old listed Georgian Hotel overlooks Kensington Park Gardens and provides elegant surroundings to enjoy the great British tradition.  Afternoon Tea is served in either The Brasserie at Hyde Park or Corus Lounge. Both settings provide stylish and sophisticated environments in which guests can indulge in a variety of delicious dishes while enjoying views of Hyde Park.  Guests wanting to enjoy a classic Afternoon Tea experience can select the Traditional Afternoon Tea featuring quintessential hallmarks of the British ritual such as fruit scones and sumptuous sweet treats.  Corus Hyde Park Hotel is situated in a vibrant area of the Capital, just a short distance from everything that the West End of London has to offer such as Buckingham Palace, Leicester Square and the City of Westminster.  Please note that Corus Hyde Park Hotel are not currently accepting cash payments. All payments must be made using credit or debit cards.
